retrievalProfile.description: A centered, high-contrast male portrait in a dark hood with ultra-thin geometric typography spanning the top edge.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot of a man wearing a dark textured hood, set against a muted, desaturated teal-grey background. The lighting is dramatic and directional, emphasizing facial structure and skin texture. The top of the frame is occupied by large, ultra-light geometric sans-serif text that overlaps the subject's hood.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with direct eye contact
Text overlapping the top of the hood
High contrast between warm skin tones and cool background
Geometric circularity in both eyes and letterforms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up, filling the middle 70% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large text at the top, down to the eyes, then following the hood line to the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced on the left and right sides of the head with a desaturated, slightly textured surface.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks of the hood and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for secondary text elements
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast on the face; low saturation in the background to make the subject pop.
paletteRestrictions: Pure white and high-chroma red for text

letterConstructionRules: Modified 'R' with a sharp, angular leg
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a distinctive diagonal kick that starts high on the stem
The 'A' has a low horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-based distinction within the same font family weight.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and sharp apexes.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A centered close-up portrait of a man with dark skin wearing a dark, textured hoodie. The background is a flat, desaturated teal-grey. Use high-contrast lighting to define facial features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-thin geometric sans-serif uppercase text across the top. The first word in white, the second in vibrant red. Ensure the text slightly overlaps the top of the hood.

verificationChecks: Is the text stroke weight ultra-thin?
Is the portrait centered with direct eye contact?
Does the text overlap the hood?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 'O' is a perfect circle
Check that the red text is high-chroma
Verify the hood texture is visible in the shadows
Confirm the text is perfectly horizontal
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Hooded Portrait + Top-Aligned Hairline Geometric Sans + Desaturated Urban Palette
